display.purpose: Hero headline (max 15ch, centered), closing CTA and page heads. Instrument Serif 400 with one italic green-700 phrase.

headline.purpose: Section heads (max 16ch); centered heads run to clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px).

title.purpose: Theme card names, bento titles, make-your-own card, empty state line. Serif 400, 25-28px.

title-sans.purpose: Item card names and label-like h3s; also the button label weight (Inter 600).

lede.purpose: Under display and page headlines, max 58ch, Graphite.

body.purpose: Default reading text, 15px/1.6; paragraphs cap at 46-52ch.

command.purpose: Install lines, copy fields, code blocks. Mono is reserved for data.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono status badges and the dark/light mode tag.

components.css: .ds-sheetdemo { --fx: 40px; background-color: var(--gutter); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.045) 0 1px, transparent 1px 8px); padding: 0 var(--fx); } .ds-paper { background: var(--bg); border-inline: 1px solid var(--frame); padding: 32px 24px; } .ds-paper h2 { margin: 0; font: 400 32px/1.08 var(--serif); letter-spacing: 0.015em; color: var(--text); } .ds-paper h2 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--green-700); } .ds-rule { position: relative; height: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--frame); margin-inline: calc(-1 * var(--fx)); } .ds-rule::before, .ds-rule::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -7px; width: 13px; height: 13px; background: linear-gradient(var(--green-900), var(--green-900)) center / 13px 1.5px no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--green-900), var(--green-900)) center / 1.5px 13px no-repeat; } .ds-rule::before { left: calc(var(--fx) - 6px); } .ds-rule::after { right: calc(var(--fx) - 6px); }

narrative.overview:
Mantle is drawn as one sheet of cream drafting paper pinned inside a ruled frame. The paper sits between two 1px side rules; outside them the gutter is a warm off-white scored with a -45° hairline stripe, so the page always reads as an object laid on a table rather than a full-bleed screen. Sections are not separated by colored bands but by full-bleed rules that cross paper and gutter alike, with small green crosshair marks where each rule meets the frame. The visual language is the user's ZeroCarbon site carried into a product gallery: Instrument Serif display with one italic green phrase, Inter for reading, JetBrains Mono only where something is a command, a value or a badge.

The paper is quiet on purpose. The only saturated color in the system belongs to the thing being sold: Mantle's themes, shown as dark specimen plates set in white mats, like prints in a catalogue. Chrome stays ink, cream and one green. This refuses the dark neon AI-tool default outright; the dark surfaces that do exist are specimens, the ink button and the toast, never page chrome.

Motion is borrowed from the Aceternity / 21st.dev component vocabulary and kept purposeful: the hero plate steps through Claude's live states, the navbar contracts into a floating pill on scroll, catalog marquees drift slowly, and a white pill slides between segmented options. Everything settles on one long-tailed ease and stops entirely under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper inside a ruled frame on a hairline-striped gutter; light-only.
Full-bleed rules with green crosshair marks divide sections.
Serif display (weight 400) with an italic green-700 accent phrase; Inter body; mono for data only.
Ink-black primary buttons that turn green on hover; cream-gradient secondary buttons.
White cards on hairlines that lift on hover.
Theme previews are the only saturated color, presented as dark plates in white mats.

rules.name: The Specimen Rule
rules.body: Saturated color appears only inside a theme preview (terminal, chat and Windows Terminal mocks, palette chips, state swatches). App chrome uses ink, paper and green.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green-700 is the only accent that carries meaning in chrome. Brighter greens mark status and glow; they never sit under text.

rules.name: The Type-Hue Rule
rules.body: The four `t-*` hues label catalog types only, always as tinted pills or icons, never as fills for buttons or sections.

rules.name: The Italic Accent Rule
rules.body: A serif headline may carry one italic phrase in green-700, at its end ("in one place.", "yours."). Never more than one, never in body text.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is reserved for commands, values, live-state names and badges. Headings and prose are never mono.

rules.name: The Light Serif Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif is set at 400 only; emphasis comes from italic and green, never weight.

rules.name: The Ruled Sheet Rule
rules.body: Sections are divided by full-bleed rules with crosshair marks, never by alternating background bands.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Paper surfaces have no shadow until hovered, focused or floating; hairlines do the structural work.

rules.name: The Mat Rule
rules.body: A theme preview is always inset in a white mat (8–12px) with its own smaller radius, never bled to a card edge.

dos: **Do** keep every page inside the ruled sheet: cream paper, 1px Frame Rule sides, hatched gutter outside.
**Do** separate sections with full-bleed rules carrying green-900 crosshair marks at the frame.
**Do** end a serif headline with at most one italic green-700 phrase.
**Do** show themes as dark specimens inset in a white mat (8–12px), with their palette chips and live-state pills beside them.
**Do** set commands, values, state names and badges in JetBrains Mono, and make every install command copyable in one click.
**Do** keep surfaces flat on hairlines at rest and lift them (Lift shadow, 3px rise) only on hover or focus.
**Do** keep text on green at 4.5:1 or better: white labels sit on green-700, not on the brighter emeralds.
**Do** honor `prefers-reduced-motion` by stopping all animation and transition.
donts: **Don't** make page chrome dark or neon; dark belongs to specimen plates, the ink button and toasts only.
**Don't** put saturated color outside a theme preview, or use the `t-*` type hues for anything but type pills and icons.
**Don't** set headings or prose in mono, or the serif at any weight above 400.
**Don't** divide sections with alternating background bands; use the rule.
**Don't** add `dark:` variants; the sheet is light-only.
**Don't** add eyebrow labels or kickers above headlines.
